question: What national wholesale price for graded, loose, white Large shell eggs will the USDA AMS Egg Markets Overview dated November 13, 2026 report? (cents per dozen)

calls.reasoning: Status quo: Oct 30 loose white Large was 35c, up 7c, with a steady undertone. The Nov 2 daily national index had Large caged at 35.42c, up 0.52c, steady to firm, which points to the current level holding or edging higher. Upside: pre-Thanksgiving demand, retail features already rising, and new layer HPAI hits (IL 935k Oct 19, CA 1.3M Oct 28, MN 940k confirmed Nov 3), about 1% of the flock combined; the price is also near the 2026 floor of 24c. Downside: a flock up 5% YoY, rising inventories, and no visible price reaction to HPAI yet. Two weekly prints remain (Nov 6, Nov 13). No human market was found (harness found none on Polymarket or Manifold; Kalshi and bookmakers were not searched this run).

calls.reasoning: Anchor: Oct 30 national trucklot loose white Large 35c (+7, steady undertone); Nov 2 daily caged Large index 35.42c, steady-to-firm. Two weekly steps remain (Nov 6, Nov 13). Upside: pre-Thanksgiving baking/feature demand in the first half of November, price near the 2026 floor (24c), fall HPAI layer losses (IL 0.93M, CA 1.3M, reportedly MN ~0.94M). Downside: flock +5.4% y/y, rising Large inventories (national +11%, Midwest +19%), negative demand indicator, no visible HPAI price reaction yet. Median modestly above status quo, right-skewed.
calls.reconciliation: The runs agreed on the factual anchors: Oct 30 print 35c, Nov 2 daily index 35.42c steady-to-firm, the same HPAI events, and the same supply data. One factual difference was the shell egg inventory change. Runs 1–2 cite +3.9% total, while the background and Run 3 cite +7%; these are probably different measures, and the difference is immaterial. Only Run 1 reports a Minnesota ~940k layer detection on Nov 3. I could not verify it without web access, but it is plausible and only slightly adds upside. Kalshi KXEGGS was not usable by any run. The rest was judgment about the size of the seasonal and HPAI tilt and the width of the lower tail. A firm daily undertone plus seasonality supports a median of about 39c. The lower tail is set at 28c, since a fall back to the 28–29c of late October is plausible but the November seasonality makes a deeper drop less likely. Dispersion is carried from Run 3's two-week SD.
